analysis: PyPI publishes a universal metapackage wheel but no sdist. Buildable source is available from the NVIDIA/TransformerEngine release tag. Fromager cannot resolve the package through its default sdist resolver, so onboarding requires a registered project override that resolves and downloads upstream source. The source build has CUDA and libtorch ABI dependencies.
jira_context: Build Transformer Engine from upstream source. Pre-built wheels are not approved.
summary: Transformer Engine 2.19.0 must be built from the NVIDIA upstream source release with a Fromager package plugin.
